# Administration-policy source excerpts

These YAML files contain selected complete records from the upstream metadata
edition identified in `provenance.json`. The selection includes ordinary,
multi-bill, unidentified-bill, and rescinded records. Each provenance entry
lists zero-based indexes in its original complete file and that file's digest.

The fixture records were parsed and serialized with PyYAML; whitespace and
quoting differ from the upstream originals. Field values, list order, and
unknown fields are retained. The source URLs are commit-pinned. Full original
bytes and live capture receipts are retained outside the repository as described
in `docs/sources/administration-policy.md`.

The upstream archive credits the Flatgov team and distinguishes official
White House PDFs from earlier UCSB American Presidency Project pages. These
fixtures are metadata observations; they contain no copied scraper code or
statement-body text.
